findings.title: Architectural seam: src/credit.mjs ↔ src/credit.test.mjs
findings.summary: The dependency between src/credit.mjs and src/credit.test.mjs is a bridge (cut-edge): its removal disconnects the two regions. A single load-bearing link is a fragility and refactor risk.

contract_findings.title: A positive discount increases the subtotal
contract_findings.summary: README.md lines 3–4 explicitly require a discount to reduce the subtotal and discountedTotal(10000, 2000) to return 8000. In src/discount.mjs line 2, discountedTotal instead adds discountCents to subtotalCents, so that same valid input returns 12000. Every positive discount on ordinary finite nonnegative amounts increases the total; the zero clamp does not enforce the documented invariant. The arithmetic needs to subtract the discount to satisfy the existing contract. This observation follows directly from the frozen source; no tests were run.
